description: Non material amendment to ref: 25/02414/FUL to allow for changes to the internal layout of two loft bedrooms.Consideration has been given to the layout to minimise disruption resulting from the proposed works and to create a better standard of accommodation.All changes proposed are internal and do not result in any external alterations to the building. Internally the realignment of dividing, non-structural walls result in two better proportioned single bedrooms.  One bedroom will measure 2.9m x 2.7m with a total floor area of 7.83 square metres.The second bedroom will measure 3.45m x 2.85m with a total floor area of 9.8 square metres.Both rooms will therefore exceed the National Internal Space Standards for a single bedroom.  Both rooms will be well lit and ventilated from the existing windows present.The existing bathroom present at the rear of the house will remain unchanged with only the door repositioned so that both bedrooms will have immediate access to the bathroom/shower, minimising possible disruption.The larger bedroom will also have access to an existing closet//dressing room which will also remain unchanged.The revised internal layout of the loft is shown on an accompanying plan, as too is the existing approved plan for the loft space and the existing plan of the loft space.The proposal therefore results in improved internal bedroom space fully compliant with internal space standards.  It results in no external elevational changes.
